_comment: ux1 P1 (feed scout, release group G1: stability and waiting states). feed.reasonUnavailable replaces the endless reason placeholder after 90s; feed.loadingA11y is announced once while the Feed skeleton shows; feed.newStoriesPill sits above the list when stories arrive while the reader is scrolled down; feed.translatingCaption sits under a title that is still being translated; trackedStories.* are the story timeline load error and the delete/remove failure toasts; articleDetail.relatedLoadFailed is the related-list error row (retry uses common.retry). No em dashes.
